facts.fact: Health Minister Mustapha Ferjani said the ministry is completing the digitisation of the medical record, centralising patient information for remote access, with an execution rate above 95 per cent.

Ferjani said the current aims are to connect primary care centres to the internet, train health professionals and introduce a unique medical identifier for every patient, on a medical record project above 95 per cent executed.
